identity.source: Authenticate inputs and actual patch, lex source tokens, persistent file lineage, scoped declaration and site plus unique parent/derived role. New monotonically allocated IDs; reject ambiguous edits, duplicated origins, unexplained macros or missing token provenance. Unique assignment outer LHS may survive an RHS-only edit.
identity.occurrence: Thread birth by parent spawn occurrence; call chain by call-site occurrence; nesting of identified loops and local iteration; current site. Ambiguous duplicate occurrence under one tuple is unsupported. Initial static occurrence, PHI, hidden definition, read/write and object roles distinct.
identity.port: Typed owner, occurrence, role including field/bit/layout. Outer result independent of RHS; internal role includes operation, lowering branch, width/sign and explicit bit/operand role. No global allocation ordinals as keys.
identity.theory: Native write-to-read and event guard payloads are authoritative. Require all interface roles to agree. No expansion of dynamic CO or theory validity decision.
identity.alias: LocalValue literal/constant/unavailable. Compare full typed keys. Reject complete connected conflict components for local multibind, splitting, merging, sign or kind conflict or incompatible theory interface. XOR the two polarities.
identity.layout: Certify actual type shape, ABI, object and field path. Common integer representation across union views; explicit exclusions for padding, incompatible views and pointer encoding lacking object interpretation. Distinguish offset from object bits only if certified.
identity.cache: Record actual conversion instances and direct roles once. Share typed child references, attach owners on actual returns/hits, expand lazily with exact uniqueness checking. Track cache clearing/rebuild; cached addresses are local handles. No re-lowering.

identity.unsupported: Reject every unhandled generator/ambiguous role; no old mapping fallback, SAT/RUP/Closure checks or per-clause choices.
